description: This file defines the Directory class, which provides static methods to initialize and access categories of items (such as balloons, bikes, androids, and pastries) in a gallery application. It constructs DirectoryCategory objects containing DirectoryEntry items with associated drawable resources.

classes.name: Directory
classes.description: A utility class that holds static methods and data for managing directory categories and entries in the gallery app.

methods.name: initializeDirectory
methods.description: Initializes the directory categories with predefined entries for various categories like balloons, bikes, androids, and pastries.

methods.name: getCategoryCount
methods.description: Returns the total number of categories available.

methods.name: getCategory
methods.description: Retrieves a specific DirectoryCategory by its index.
